ns2:section.sectionText: Serving Homeless Patrons In Public Libraries (Seminar in Contemporary Issues): What do homeless patrons need? A place to rest, a place to be safe, connections to service providers, and to feel welcome. The library can provide all of this and more. With homelessness on the rise, many public libraries are serving homeless patrons. This 1-unit course will cover the current state of homelessness, serving homeless patrons at the library, barriers that come up, partnering with organizations, and inclusive programs created for homeless patrons. Students must meet minimum technology requirements as specified on these pages: https://ischool.sjsu.edu/home-computing-environment and https://ischool.sjsu.edu/post/application-software and https://ischool.sjsu.edu/pod/technology-literacy-requirements.
